newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein eases in late thin trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein eases in late thin trading.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices eased slightly in late trading on Wednesday despite sufficient demand, traders said.
"Demand is enough, but trade is slow today and prices have eased a bit," said one trader.

Traders said palm olein was quoted at 1,445-50 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, slightly lower than morning's levels of 1,450-55 rupiah/kg. Crude palm oil was last sold on Saturday at an equivalent 1,270 rupiah/kg in a 1,000-tonne tender in Medan.
Traders said demand was still firm ahead of the Eid al-Fitr celebrations on February 9 and 10.
The data from Belawan Port in north Sumatra showed that MT Tirta Kencana was scheduled to leave on Wednesday for Cirebon in West Java with 1,600 tonnes of palm olein.
